description: Maddage Semapala v. Devika Weerakoon & Others Maddage Semapala v. Devika Weerakoon & Others View More before Hon. A.W.A. Salam, J.
parties: Maddage Semapala v. Devika Weerakoon & Others Maddage Semapala v. Devika Weerakoon & Others View More
keywords: The Plaintiff instituted a partition action in the District Court of Horana raising the question of interpretation of a deed of gift No. 19977, as regards the intention of the vendor who parted with rights to an immovable property. Held — on a perusal of the deed it was clear that the grantor was dealing with the share of the entire land and not a specific proportion of his entitlement; the District Court\'s construction of the deed was rational, logical and involved no error or misdirection; appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
